title: crataegus × media var. intermixta
intro: Crataegus × media var. intermixta, commonly known as the hawthorn, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). The health benefits of Crataegus × media var. intermixta include its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and improve lipid profiles due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include cardiotonic, vasodilatory, and anti-ischemic effects, which help to improve blood flow and reduce the risk of heart disease. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus × media var. intermixta include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
